item.title: Walk Anyway, the short film

turns.text:
Make a 30-second 16:9 short film called Walk Anyway from this description. There are no reference images.

Characters: a tall woman with a silver bob, a red raincoat and yellow boots. An older man with a grey beard, a green coat and a black umbrella. Keep both looking the same in every shot.

Start on a title card for 2 seconds: black background, white text "WALK ANYWAY".

Then four shots, in this order:
1. Night, rain. The woman waits alone at a bus stop.
2. The man walks up with his umbrella and stops beside her.
3. Close on both of them. He says out loud: "You came back." She smiles.
4. They walk away together under the umbrella, seen from behind.

End on the same title card for 2 seconds, so the video loops back to its first frame.

Sound: rain, and his one line. No music and no narrator. Give me one finished video file.

answer_sheet.Title card: Black background, white text WALK ANYWAY, 2 seconds at the start and the same card for 2 seconds at the end.
answer_sheet.Shots: Night, rain, she waits alone at a bus stop; he walks up with his umbrella and stops beside her; close on both, he says You came back. and she smiles; they walk away together under the umbrella, seen from behind.
answer_sheet.Sound: Rain, and his one line: You came back. No music and no narrator.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 30-second 16:9 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One playable 16:9 video file runs for 30 seconds, plus or minus 1 second.
The video starts on a title card for 2 seconds: black background, white text WALK ANYWAY.
Four shots appear in the requested order.
The woman keeps her silver bob, red raincoat and yellow boots; the man keeps his grey beard, green coat and black umbrella.
The man says "You came back." out loud, and no other words are spoken.
Rain is audible; there is no music and no narrator.
The video ends on the same title card, so the last frame matches the first frame.
